The company primarily operates within the home improvement and building materials sector, offering products such as acrylic solid surfaces, modified acrylic sheets, AASA Laminates, and Zinc Surfaces (DLZINC).

GMDCLTD.NS.d: Gujarat Mineral Development Corporation Limited engages in mining business in India. It operates in two segments, Mining and Power. The company explores for lignite, bauxite, fluorspar, manganese, silica sand, limestone, bentonite, and ball clay. It also generates power using thermal, wind, and solar sources. The company was incorporated in 1963 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

GMMPFAUDLR.NS.d: GMM Pfaudler Limited manufactures and sells corrosion resistant glass-lined equipment used primarily in the chemical, pharmaceutical, and allied industries in India and internationally. The company operates through five segments: Glass Lined Equipment, Heavy Engineering, Mixing Systems, Engineered Systems, and Filtration & Drying.

GROWW.NS.d: Billionbrains Garage Ventures Limited operates Groww, a digital investment platform that sells directly to customers. Users can trade and invest in stocks, also via IPOs, as well as derivatives, bonds and mutual funds, and can use margin trading and personal loan facilities.

JETKNIT-SM.NS.d: JET KNITWEARS LTD is an Indian textile company engaged in the manufacturing and trading of knitted fabrics and garments. The company offers a range of products including knitted fabrics, readymade garments, and hosiery items, catering to both domestic and international markets. The company is based in India.

JUBLINGREA.NS.d: Jubilant Ingrevia Limited provides life science products and solutions in India and internationally. It operates in three segments: Specialty Chemicals, Nutrition & Health Solutions, and Life Science Chemicals. The Specialty Chemicals segment offers specialty ingredients, fine chemicals, crop protection chemicals, and contract development and manufacturing services.

KANANIIND.NS.d: Kanani Industries Limited engages in the manufacture and retail of diamond studded jewelry in India. The company offers its jewelry to wholesalers, jewelry manufacturers, traders, and retailers. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as IMP Finance Limited and changed its name to Kanani Industries Limited in October 2007. Kanani Industries Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Mumbai, India.

LOTUSCHO.NS.d: Lotus Chocolate Company Limited is an Indian chocolate and cocoa products manufacturer. The company produces chocolate ingredients, chocolate bars, and other confectionery products. The company caters to both domestic and international markets.

MANAPPURAM.NS.d: Manappuram Finance Limited, a non-banking financial company, provides retail credit products and financial services in India. The company offers loans against the pledge of household and used gold jewelry, as well as short-term personal and business gold loans; microfinance loans and other financial services to low income population; loans for construction, extension, purchase, and improvement of homes; loans for hospitality industry; tour and travel loan; and vehicle loans.

PALREDTEC.NS.d: Palred Technologies Limited engages in the e-commerce, information technology, and media and entertainment businesses in India. It offers middleware and master data management services.

PANCHMAHQ.NS.d: Panchmahal Steel Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of steel products. The company offers a range of steel products. Panchmahal Steel Limited is based in India.

RBS.NS.d: Ramdevbaba Solvent Ltd. operates in the agro-industrial sector, primarily focusing on the manufacturing, distribution, marketing, and sale of physically refined rice bran oil. The company offers its rice bran oil under its proprietary brands, "Tulsi" and "Sehat," which are distributed to retailers, wholesalers, and other distributors, mainly across Maharashtra.

RELTD.NS.d: Ravindra Energy Limited (REL) is an Indian company mainly in solar energy, offering solar pumping solutions and building solar power plants, including PV pumping systems, rooftop installations and ground-mounted arrays, with a strong presence in Karnataka, Maharashtra and Rajasthan. It sells electricity it generates and trades in sugar and coal. It dates from 1980.

RENTOMOJO.NS.d: Rentomojo Ltd. runs an online rental service for furniture and appliances, handling delivery, installation and pick-up. Founded in 2012, it is based in Bengaluru, India.

RUNWALENTR.NS.d: Runwal Enterprises Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker RUNWALENTR and traded in INR. Its country is India.

SHREERAMA.NS.d: Shree Rama Multi-Tech Limited manufactures and sells packaging products primarily in India. Its packaging products include multilayer tubes for packing dentifrices, cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, food, and other products; monolayer tubes; paper and plastic containers for hot or cold beverages, and dairy and other products; and multi-colored labels and stickers for breweries, chemicals, cosmetics, food and beverages, pharmaceuticals, and other industrial products.

SIKKO.NS.d: Sikko Industries Limited, established in Ahmedabad in 1997, is a diversified company making and selling agricultural inputs and consumer products in India. Its bio-agro chemicals include organic pesticides, fungicides, adhesion agents and plant growth enhancers, and it also provides chemical fertilizers.

SOMANYCERA.NS.d: Somany Ceramics Limited manufactures and sells ceramic tiles and related products in India. It offers ceramic wall and floor tiles, polished vitrified tiles, glazed vitrified tiles, sanitaryware, and bath fittings, as well as tile laying solutions. It provides its products under the Somany Duragress, Somany Durastone, Somany Glostra, Somany Vistoso, Somany Vitro, Somany Slipshield, Somany VC Shield, Somany Signature, and Somany French Collection brands. The company also exports its products.

SRTRANSFIN-Z4.NS.d: Sec Red NCD 9.22% Sr.II represents a secured, redeemable, non-convertible debenture issued by Shriram Transport Finance Limited, offering a fixed interest rate of 9.22% and belonging to Series II of the issuance; it is a debt instrument used by the company to raise capital from the public; Shriram Transport Finance Limited is an asset financing NBFC focused on providing financing solutions to commercial vehicle owners.

SRTRANSFIN-ZB.NS.d: Sec Red NCD Sr.IX represents a secured, redeemable, non-convertible debenture issued by Shriram Transport Finance Limited, belonging to Series IX of the issuance; it is a debt instrument used by the company to raise capital from the public; Shriram Transport Finance Limited is an asset financing NBFC focused on providing financing solutions to commercial vehicle owners.

SUNDRMFAST.NS.d: Sundram Fasteners Limited manufactures and sells precision components for the automotive, infrastructure, windmill, and aviation sectors in India, China, Germany, the United States, the United Kingdom, Italy, France, and Brazil.

SWELECTES.NS.d: Swelect Energy Systems Limited manufactures and trades in solar modules, mounting structures, transformers, and inverters in India, Europe, and internationally. The company operates through Solar and Solar Related Activities, Foundry Business, and Others segments. It offers mono and multi crystalline solar photovoltaic modules, and building integrated photovoltaic modules; solar inverters; solar water pumps; and hydro panels. The company also engages in iron, steel, and investment casting activities.

SYMPHONY.NS.d: Symphony Limited manufactures and trades in residential, commercial, and industrial air coolers and other appliances in India and internationally. The company offers large and medium space coolers, and spot coolers for household use; commercial coolers for use in workshops, restaurants, gyms, and indoor stadiums; and heavy duty air coolers for open and semi-open spaces. It sells its products primarily under the Symphony brand name in approximately 60 countries.

VERTOZ.NS.d: Vertoz Advertising Limited provides media buying and programmatic advertising solutions worldwide. Its Ingenious Plex media buying platform offers real-time trading of digital advertising between advertisers and publishers. The company was formerly known as Vertoz Media Limited and changed its name to Vertoz Advertising Limited in June 2017. Vertoz Advertising Limited was founded in 2012 and is based in Mumbai, India.

VINYAS.NS.d: Vinyas Innovative Technologies Ltd. is an India-based integrated electronic manufacturing services (EMS) provider. The company specializes in offering design, engineering, and electronics manufacturing services to Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) and Original Design Manufacturers (ODMs) across various industries. Its core services include printed circuit board (PCB) assembly, cable harness assembly, and system integration, along with advanced test solutions, product integration, and box build assemblies.

VOLTAMP.NS.d: Voltamp Transformers Limited manufactures and sells various electrical transformers. The company offers oil filled transformers, cast resin transformers, unitized sub-stations, induction furnace transformers, and lighting transformers. It also provides repair, overhauling, conversion, and maintenance services for transformers; and supplies spares for transformers.
